llm.summary: This is an instruction-only response-compression skill with no code, credentials, persistence, or data access, though users should enable it only when concise answers are appropriate.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to reduce verbose responses by removing filler and redundant framing; the artifact content is aligned with that purpose and does not introduce unrelated capabilities.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The triggers are broad and may activate during ordinary discussion of tokens, efficiency, communication, or directness, but the resulting behavior is limited to response style guidance.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The bundle contains only SKILL.md, with no executable scripts, dependencies, package installs, hooks, or setup commands.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, local files, network calls, shell commands, or external APIs are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, privilege escalation, background workers, stored memory, account mutation, or profile/session access is present.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install this if you want shorter, more direct responses. Avoid enabling it globally for teaching, sensitive advice, or complex debugging where careful uncertainty, context, and step-by-step detail matter.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: The broad trigger concern is artifact-supported, but it affects activation of a style-compression skill rather than granting sensitive access or authority.
[SQP-3] expected: The hedging-removal wording is artifact-supported, but the same SKILL.md also tells the agent to preserve safety warnings, technical precision, clarifying questions, warnings about destructive operations, and factual uncertainty markers, which reduces the risk.
